description: Source code for jemalloc profiling subsystem, including backtrace collection, profile data management, and dump functions.

classes.name: prof_bt_t
classes.description: Structure representing a backtrace, containing an array of instruction pointers and its length.

classes.name: prof_ctx_t
classes.description: Context structure for profiling, including backtrace, mutex lock, and statistics.

classes.name: prof_tdata_t
classes.description: Thread-specific data for profiling, including cache of backtraces and counters.

classes.name: prof_thr_cnt_t
classes.description: Per-thread counter structure linked to profiling context.

methods.name: bt_init
methods.description: Initialize a backtrace object with a given vector.

methods.name: bt_dup
methods.description: Duplicate a backtrace object, creating a contiguous copy.

methods.name: prof_backtrace
methods.description: Collect a backtrace using available unwinding methods.

methods.name: prof_tdata_cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup thread-specific profiling data, merging counters and freeing resources.

methods.name: prof_boot1
methods.description: Set profiling options before arena initialization.

methods.name: prof_boot2
methods.description: Complete profiling setup, including hash tables and mutexes.

methods.name: prof_postfork_parent
methods.description: Reinitialize mutexes after fork in parent process.

methods.name: prof_postfork_child
methods.description: Reinitialize mutexes after fork in child process.
